In the launcher it is on the Experimental tab, which only a game's own settings show: right-click the game > Game-specific Settings... > Create Game-specific Settings from Global Settings (or Configure Game-specific Settings) > Experimental > Additional DMem Allocation, then Save. Turn the other resolution toggles off.

Metadata.Note: For GR2fork builds with FSR upscaling for Gravity Rush Remastered. The 3D scene renders at 3440x1440 and FSR upscales it to 10328x4320; the HUD and text render at 10328x4320. Also turn on Enable FSR 3.1 or Enable FSR 4 (INT8, experimental) (Settings > Mods > Gravity Rush Remastered, or Ctrl+F10 > Display > FSR 3.1 (GRR)); with both off the scene is upscaled bilinearly (or with FSR 1 EASU when EASU fallback is on), and on other builds bilinearly, without anti-aliasing. FSR 4 supports outputs up to 7680x4320, so this toggle needs Enable FSR 3.1. Raises the GPU memory pool from 3 GB to 4096 MB, so it needs Additional DMem Allocation 2048 (extra_dmem_in_mbytes). In the launcher it is on the Experimental tab, which only a game's own settings show: right-click the game > Game-specific Settings... > Create Game-specific Settings from Global Settings (or Configure Game-specific Settings) > Experimental > Additional DMem Allocation, then Save. Turn the other resolution toggles off.
Metadata.Author: Junmin Lee

Metadata.Note: For GR2fork builds with FSR upscaling for Gravity Rush Remastered. The 3D scene renders at 1536x480 and FSR upscales it to 2304x720; the HUD and text render at 2304x720. Also turn on Enable FSR 3.1 or Enable FSR 4 (INT8, experimental) (Settings > Mods > Gravity Rush Remastered, or Ctrl+F10 > Display > FSR 3.1 (GRR)); with both off the scene is upscaled bilinearly (or with FSR 1 EASU when EASU fallback is on), and on other builds bilinearly, without anti-aliasing. Turn the other resolution toggles off.
